task: [Project: Nova/deploy-agent] Configure the deployment region for Nova's deploy-agent service.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Nova] deploy-agent is deployed exclusively to us-east-1; Nova's data residency agreement prohibits deployment outside the US.
[Project: Nova] DEPLOY_REGION is set in nova/deploy-agent/helm/values.yaml; the value must remain us-east-1; do not inherit from the cluster default.
[Project: Atlas] deploy-agent is deployed to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 to serve European customers; Atlas has EU data residency requirements.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Atlas; EU residency constraint conflicts with Nova US-only

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Cobalt] deploy-agent is deployed globally (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1); Cobalt has no data residency restrictions.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Cobalt; global deployment conflicts with Nova US-only

candidate_memories.content: [General] Deployment region should match customer geography to reduce latency; data residency requirements take precedence over latency.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general principle, Nova-specific constraint is authoritative

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Nova] Legal review confirmed us-east-1 is sufficient for Nova's current customer base and compliance obligations.
